comment: Generated by proto/go/zs TestSolanaRegistryVectors from the accounts in solana_account_vectors.json. genesis_hash is what getGenesisHash answers and deployment_hex the deployment id read from it; operator_params and node_params are the getProgramAccounts params each read sends. Each case's want, skipped and error are compared exactly, skipped as sorted by account.

cases.name: the program's fixtures
revenue windows end days after the ring's last write
a ring thirty days old reads as no revenue
a clock behind the ring reads no revenue
an evicted operator's nodes are left out
an operator status a later program adds still routes
the node status byte is not read
any non-zero staging byte is staging
trailing zero padding and slashes are trimmed from the base URL
a base URL with no scheme is skipped
an uppercase scheme is skipped
a later program's node account fails the read
a later program's operator account fails the read
an account the program does not own is skipped
no operator accounts is an empty fleet
an evicted operator alone is a fleet with no nodes
operator ids restrict the read
a requested operator not on chain fails the read
nodes are sorted by operator then node
a node whose operator has no account is left out
a negative activity time and ring day read as never
